sentences.text: The present application filed under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (erstwhile Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973) seeks regular bail in proceedings arising from FIR No. 1069/2024 registered under Sections 376/506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at P.S., Shahbad Dairy, Outer North District, Delhi.
Upon conclusion of investigation, chargesheet was filed, inter alia, against the Applicant for the offences under Section 376/328/506/323/34 of the IPC.
2. Issue notice. Mr. Hitesh Vali, APP for the State, accepts notice.
3. Status Report be filed before the next date of hearing.
4. The Trial Court is requested to expedite the recording of the testimony of the Prosecutrix.

5. Issue notice to the Prosecutrix through the Investigating Officer, returnable on the next date of hearing.
This is a digitally signed order.
